annotations.title: Evaluate a HIP-3 trade (read-only, never signs)

description: transaction scope. Call this BEFORE an agent places a HIP-3 / trade.xyz order. Verdict is allow | review | do_not_trade, with the rule that fired (notional above cap, market not allowed, leverage too high). Returns the decision and a one-line reason. Local policy only: this is not financial advice, holds no keys, and cannot place or cancel an order. Prices come from a read-only market query. Fails closed: do not invent authority — a missing policy, identity, cost or evidence is a refusal, never a default.
name: evaluate_hip3_trade
